blogPosts.title: How Much Do Custom Kitchen Cabinets Cost in Melton?
blogPosts.excerpt: A comprehensive guide to kitchen cabinetry pricing for Melton homeowners, covering materials, design complexity, and what affects your final investment.
body: If you're planning a kitchen renovation in Melton, one of the first questions on your mind is likely: how much will custom kitchen cabinets cost? The answer depends on several factors, including the size of your kitchen, the materials you choose, the complexity of the design, and the level of customisation required. For Melton homeowners, custom kitchen cabinetry typically ranges from $5,000 for a basic single-wall layout to $25,000 or more for a large, fully fitted kitchen with premium finishes. At Cumbo's Cabinets, we've been building custom kitchens for Melton families for over 20 years, and we understand that every budget is different. The key is understanding where your money goes and making informed choices that balance quality, durability, and style for your specific Melton home.

The materials you select play a significant role in determining your kitchen cabinet cost. Melton homeowners can choose from a range of options, including melamine-faced particleboard for budget-friendly projects, polyurethane-painted MDF for a sleek modern finish, and solid timber or timber veneer for a classic, warm aesthetic. In Melbourne's western suburbs, where homes range from period-style properties to modern builds in newer estates like those in Brookfield and Kurunjang, the material choice should complement your home's existing character. Premium hardware, such as soft-close hinges and drawer runners from brands like Blum, add approximately 10-15% to material costs but significantly improve the daily experience of using your kitchen.

Kitchen layout and design complexity are the biggest cost drivers for Melton cabinet projects. A straightforward galley or single-wall kitchen with standard dimensions will cost considerably less than an L-shaped or U-shaped kitchen with island bench, corner units, and integrated appliances. In Melton's newer developments, open-plan living areas often require larger kitchen configurations with feature elements like waterfall benchtops, display cabinets, and pull-out pantry systems. Each additional feature requires more design time, more materials, and more precision in the workshop — all of which factor into your final quote. We always recommend Melton homeowners consider their daily workflow and storage needs before committing to a layout.

When comparing quotes from cabinet makers in Melton and the broader western suburbs, it's important to understand what's included. A cheap quote might exclude installation, benchtops, handles, or kickboards — costs that add up quickly. At Cumbo's Cabinets, our Melton-based quotes include everything: design, manufacture, delivery, and professional installation by our experienced team. We also account for Melbourne's unique climate considerations, ensuring that materials and construction methods withstand the region's hot summers and cool winters without warping, swelling, or deteriorating. This all-inclusive approach gives our Melton clients genuine peace of mind.

For Melton homeowners on a tighter budget, there are smart ways to achieve a high-end look without the premium price tag. Refacing existing cabinet boxes with new doors and drawer fronts can save up to 40% compared to a full replacement. Choosing a two-tone colour scheme — with painted lower doors and timber-look uppers — creates visual interest while keeping material costs balanced. Our Melton workshop can also recommend cost-effective alternatives to popular finishes, such as laminates that replicate the look of natural stone or timber veneers at a fraction of the price. We work with every Melton client to find the sweet spot between their dream kitchen and their budget.

Timing your kitchen renovation in Melton can also affect costs. Many cabinet makers, including Cumbo's Cabinets, offer more flexible scheduling during quieter periods, which can translate to faster turnaround times and less pressure on your project timeline. We recommend starting the design process at least 6-8 weeks before your desired installation date, allowing adequate time for design finalisation, material sourcing, and workshop production. If you're in Melton or surrounding suburbs like Taylors Hill or Hillside, we invite you to visit our Harrison Court workshop to see our materials, finishes, and craftsmanship firsthand before making any decisions.

blogPosts.title: Best Bathroom Vanity Designs for Melton Homes in 2026
blogPosts.excerpt: Explore trending bathroom vanity styles suited to Melton homes, from space-saving designs to luxury floating vanities built by local cabinet makers.
body: The bathroom vanity is one of the most important elements in any Melton home renovation, serving as both a functional workstation and a style statement. In 2026, Melton homeowners are gravitating towards designs that balance modern aesthetics with practical storage — a trend that perfectly suits custom cabinetry. Whether you live in an established family home in Melton South or a newer property in Kurunjang, choosing the right vanity design can completely transform your bathroom's look and feel. At Cumbo's Cabinets, our Melton workshop has seen a significant increase in custom vanity projects, reflecting the suburb's ongoing growth and the desire among local homeowners for personalised, quality bathroom solutions.

Floating vanities remain the most popular choice for Melton bathrooms in 2026, and for good reason. Wall-mounted designs create the illusion of more floor space — a critical advantage in Melton's typical three-bedroom ensuite and main bathroom layouts. By exposing floor tiles beneath the vanity, floating designs make bathrooms feel larger and more open while simplifying cleaning. Cumbo's Cabinets builds custom floating vanities in widths from 600mm to 1800mm, using moisture-resistant substrates and marine-grade finishes to ensure longevity in Melbourne's variable humidity conditions. Popular colour choices among Melton clients include matte white, charcoal grey, and natural timber tones that complement the suburb's predominantly neutral bathroom tile palettes.

For Melton families who need maximum storage, vanity designs with integrated drawers and organisers are in high demand. Traditional under-basin cabinets waste space with awkward angles and limited access, but modern drawer-based vanities with U-shaped cutouts around plumbing provide full access to every centimetre of storage. In Melton homes, where family bathrooms need to accommodate everything from children's toiletries to bulk supplies, these intelligent storage solutions make daily routines significantly easier. Our Melton workshop uses full-extension drawer runners and soft-close mechanisms as standard, ensuring smooth operation even when drawers are loaded with heavy bottles and towels.

Double vanities are an increasingly popular request from Melton homeowners, particularly in master ensuites where couples share the space. In Melton's growing residential areas, newer homes are being built with larger ensuite footprints that comfortably accommodate dual-basin configurations. A well-designed double vanity eliminates morning bottlenecks while adding significant resale value to your property. At Cumbo's Cabinets, we design double vanities with either shared or separate drawer banks, allowing each user their own storage while maintaining a cohesive, symmetrical appearance. We can also incorporate charging stations, illuminated mirrors, and integrated power points — features that Melton clients increasingly request.

Material selection for bathroom vanities in Melton requires careful consideration of the region's climate. Melbourne's west experiences temperature extremes, from 40-degree summer days to chilly winter mornings, and bathrooms are particularly susceptible to moisture and condensation damage. Cumbo's Cabinets specifies moisture-resistant MDF, marine plywood, and sealed timber veneers for all Melton vanity projects, ensuring your investment withstands years of daily use. Benchtop options include engineered stone, solid surface materials, and high-pressure laminates, each offering different benefits in terms of durability, maintenance, and cost. Our Melton team can walk you through each option during your free in-home consultation.

If you're considering a bathroom vanity upgrade in Melton, Brookfield, or surrounding suburbs, the best approach is to start with a professional consultation. Every bathroom is different, and factors like plumbing locations, wall construction, and existing layouts all influence what's possible. Cumbo's Cabinets offers free design consultations to Melton homeowners, where we assess your space, discuss your requirements, and provide a detailed, no-obligation quote. With over 20 years of experience crafting bathroom cabinetry for Melbourne's western suburbs, we have the expertise to recommend solutions that suit your budget, style, and practical needs perfectly.

blogPosts.title: Walk-In Robe Storage Solutions for Growing Melton Families
blogPosts.excerpt: How Melton families can maximise bedroom storage with custom walk-in robe cabinetry designed by local cabinet making experts.
body: As families grow, so does the need for smart storage — and for many Melton homeowners, the walk-in robe is where the battle for organisation begins. In Melbourne's western suburbs, where three and four-bedroom homes dominate the residential landscape, bedrooms often need to serve double duty as wardrobes, study spaces, and personal retreats. A custom walk-in robe system can reclaim bedroom space by consolidating clothing, shoes, accessories, and personal items into one dedicated, organised area. At Cumbo's Cabinets, our Melton workshop has designed and installed hundreds of WIR systems for local families, transforming cluttered bedrooms into calm, functional living spaces. Understanding how Melton families actually use their wardrobes is the first step in creating a system that works.

The foundation of any effective walk-in robe is intelligent layout design that accounts for your specific wardrobe and available space. Melton homes vary considerably — from compact ensuites with small walk-in robe nooks in older properties to generous master suite configurations in newer developments around Taylors Hill and Hillside. Our Melton-based design team measures every dimension carefully, accounting for door swings, ceiling heights, existing electrical points, and access requirements. We then create a custom layout that maximises every available centimetre, incorporating hanging rails at multiple heights, adjustable shelving for folded items, dedicated shoe storage, and drawer units for smaller garments.

For growing Melton families, flexibility in walk-in robe design is essential. Children's wardrobes need to accommodate changing requirements as they grow, from low hanging rails for small school uniforms to taller configurations for teenagers. Cumbo's Cabinets builds adjustable shelving systems and modular components into every Melton WIR project, allowing the configuration to evolve as your family's needs change. Our standard adjustable shelf increments of 32mm mean you can reposition shelves at any time without tools or modifications, future-proofing your investment and ensuring the walk-in robe remains functional for years to come.

Melton homeowners increasingly request specific organisational features in their walk-in robe projects. Popular additions include pull-out tie and belt racks, jewellery drawer dividers, built-in hampers with ventilation, shoe shelves angled for display, and integrated LED lighting systems. While these features add to the initial investment, they dramatically improve the daily usability of the space and help maintain organisation over time. At our Melton workshop, we work with premium hardware suppliers to ensure every pull-out mechanism, hinge, and fitting operates smoothly and reliably, backed by manufacturer warranties and our own workmanship guarantee.

Material selection for walk-in robe cabinetry should balance aesthetics, durability, and cost-effectiveness. For Melton families, melamine and laminate finishes remain the most popular choice due to their wide colour range, scratch resistance, and easy maintenance — practical benefits for busy family wardrobes. Those seeking a premium aesthetic may opt for timber veneer or two-pack painted finishes, which add warmth and sophistication to the space. Cumbo's Cabinets sources all materials through established Australian suppliers, ensuring consistent quality, accurate colour matching, and reliable availability for Melton projects. We can show you physical samples during your free in-home consultation.

If you're considering a walk-in robe renovation or new-build installation in Melton, Brookfield, or Kurunjang, the process begins with understanding how you currently use your wardrobe space and where the frustrations lie. Common complaints we hear from Melton families include insufficient hanging space, poor visibility of stored items, and wasted corner areas. blogPosts.title: Kitchen Renovation Planning Guide for Melton Homeowners
blogPosts.excerpt: A step-by-step guide to planning your Melton kitchen renovation, from initial design through to installation by local cabinet makers.
body: Renovating your kitchen is one of the most impactful home improvements you can make as a Melton homeowner, adding both daily enjoyment and significant resale value to your property. However, a successful kitchen renovation requires careful planning, realistic budgets, and the right team of professionals to bring your vision to life. Melbourne's western suburbs, including Melton, Brookfield, and Kurunjang, have seen a surge in kitchen renovations as the area continues to grow and mature, with homeowners increasingly choosing to invest in their existing properties rather than move. At Cumbo's Cabinets, we've guided hundreds of Melton families through the renovation process, and we've developed a proven approach that minimises stress and maximises results.

The planning phase is the most critical stage of any Melton kitchen renovation, and it should begin at least 3-6 months before you want your new kitchen installed. Start by assessing your current kitchen's shortcomings — is the storage insufficient, the layout inefficient, or the style outdated? Create a wish list of everything you'd like in your new kitchen, then prioritise based on your budget and daily needs. For Melton homeowners, a professional design consultation is invaluable at this stage. Our Melton-based designers can assess your existing space, identify structural limitations like plumbing locations and load-bearing walls, and develop a layout that optimises workflow while incorporating your must-have features.

Budgeting for a Melton kitchen renovation requires understanding the various cost components beyond just cabinetry. While custom cabinets typically represent 30-40% of a total kitchen renovation budget, you also need to account for benchtops, splashbacks, plumbing, electrical work, tiling, and painting. For a mid-range kitchen renovation in Melton, including all elements, homeowners should budget between $20,000 and $40,000, with premium renovations easily exceeding $50,000. Cumbo's Cabinets provides detailed, itemised quotes to Melton clients that clearly separate cabinet costs from other trade requirements, helping you allocate your overall budget effectively and avoid unexpected shortfalls during the project.

Choosing the right cabinet maker is arguably the most important decision in your Melton kitchen renovation. Your cabinets form the backbone of the kitchen — they need to be precisely manufactured, properly finished, and expertly installed to function well for decades. When evaluating cabinet makers in Melton and Melbourne's west, ask to see examples of previous work, request references from past clients, and verify that they operate from a proper workshop rather than simply reselling imported flat-pack products. At Cumbo's Cabinets, our Harrison Court workshop houses state-of-the-art CNC machinery and a skilled team of tradespeople who craft every cabinet locally, giving Melton homeowners complete control over quality, timelines, and design flexibility.

Material selection for Melton kitchen cabinets involves balancing aesthetics, durability, and maintenance requirements. Popular choices among Melton homeowners include polyurethane-painted MDF for a smooth, modern finish, two-pack cabinetry for a premium look, timber veneer for warmth and character, and high-pressure laminate for budget-conscious projects. Melbourne's climate, with its hot dry summers and cool damp winters, means material expansion and contraction must be considered — all Cumbo's Cabinets' Melton projects use appropriate substrates and construction methods to accommodate seasonal movement. We maintain an extensive sample library at our Melton workshop, allowing you to see, touch, and compare materials in person before making your selection.

The installation phase is where your Melton kitchen renovation truly comes together, and it demands precision and experience. Cumbo's Cabinets' installation team completes all kitchen installations personally, rather than subcontracting — ensuring the same standards maintained in our Melton workshop carry through to your home. Typical kitchen installations take 3-5 days, during which our team fits all cabinetry, adjusts doors and drawers, installs hardware, and completes all finishing details. We coordinate with your plumber and electrician to ensure connections are completed efficiently, and we leave your Melton home clean and tidy at the end of each day.

After installation, Cumbo's Cabinets provides every Melton kitchen client with a comprehensive care guide and our written workmanship guarantee. We recommend annual checks of all hardware, soft-close mechanisms, and sealant joints to keep your kitchen performing at its best. Melbourne's hard water can affect tapware and finishes over time, so our care guide includes specific recommendations for maintaining your cabinetry in local conditions. Most importantly, we're always available to Melton clients for adjustments, repairs, or advice — our reputation in the western suburbs is built on long-term relationships, not one-off transactions.

Planning a kitchen renovation in Melton, Melton South, or surrounding suburbs? Contact Cumbo's Cabinets on (03) 9743 0199 to arrange a free in-home design consultation. Our experienced team will assess your space, discuss your vision, and provide a detailed, no-obligation quote. With over 20 years of experience, a fully equipped Melton workshop, and hundreds of successful kitchen renovations behind us, we're confident we can deliver the kitchen your family deserves.
